Laura —

Attached is a concise decision matrix I put together (see region-decision-matrix.pdf). Key points in short:

- Hosted: fastest to production (2–3 business days once account provisioned), predictable low-touch ops, best for initial eval. Typical p95/p99 for US-east is ~40/85ms for 512-token responses on our curated LLMs; p99 under 100ms is achievable with autoscaling and prefix caching.
- Dedicated: recommended if they need predictable sustained throughput and data isolation without full private control plane. Setup runway ~2–3 weeks (GPU provisioning + model pinning), and we can hit lower unit cost at commits >= 3k GPU hours/month. p99 improves ~10–20% vs hosted depending on instance family.
- Private (VPC/on-prem): provides strongest isolation and customer-managed networking. Expect 6–10 week lead time for an on-prem deployment and more engineering coordination; VPC-private (our managed private) can be 3–4 weeks. Latency will be determined by their networking; we'll provide kernel/tuning guidance.

Potential blockers: air-gapped on-prem requires additional security review and custom packaging (not in scope for a 2-week PoC). For staging VPC PoC we just need an inbound firewall/peering window and an SSO OIDC thumbprint.

I've flagged items in the PDF where we need MedicaHealth to confirm token size distribution and expected concurrency.

—Karthik
Senior Solutions Architect
Redwood Inference

Attachments: region-decision-matrix.pdf

Laura / team —

High level commercial assumptions I'm using for the MAP (sketch):
- Baseline usage assumption: 75M inference tokens/month (mixed short and long contexts); average concurrency 40 qps during peak.
- Hosted pricing (public API): $0.0009 per output token + request overhead; estimated monthly $67k under above assumptions.
- Dedicated 1-year commit (NVIDIA A100-class equivalent): committed rate discount ~35% vs hosted, plus flat monthly platform fee. Estimated monthly cost after discounts: ~$43k, plus initial setup credits.
- Private (VPC or on-prem): one-time deployment fee + support tier; unit cost close to dedicated after we amortize setup. SLA add-on available for dedicated and private.

Commercial notes:
- To meet their audit/unpinning concerns, we can offer a 60-day rollback window for model version pinning as part of dedicated contracts.
- We typically require a 30% deposit for dedicated annual commits.

I'll put these figures into the MAP spreadsheet (MedicaHealth-MAP-v2.xlsx) with a TCO view for 12 months and a quick sensitivity table (±25% usage).

Team —

Draft evaluation plan (to be inserted in the MAP):
1) Week 0: Kickoff + security intake (collect contact, SSO, firewall windows, SOC2 checklist).
2) Week 1–2: Staging PoC (hosted or VPC staging): run 3 canonical prompts, perf benchmarks (p50/p95/p99), and a small data-integration test. Acceptance gate: p99 within 120ms and functional parity on outputs for our chosen prompt set.
3) Week 3–4: Scale/throughput validation on dedicated pool (if committed) or stress test on hosted with autoscaling. Acceptance: sustained throughput at 2x projected peak for 30 minutes with <2% error rate.
4) Week 5–6: Security handoff and contractual close (DocuSign link in MAP).

I'll add specific artifacts in the MAP: test prompts, perf dashboard queries, and a small eval harness we can run with their team. Also attaching SOC2-evidence-brief.pdf for quick procurement review.
